meta.title: 眉毛居然是决定颜值的重要因素？

scenes.context: 眉毛是决定颜值的重要因素。中庭长，眉就要平；中庭短，眉就要挑。根据中庭比例调整眉毛的高低走向。语域：美妆口诀，脸型分析。
sentences: Long midface? Keep the brows flat.
Short midface? Arch the brows up.
眉毛是决定颜值的重要因素。
Brows are a key factor in your looks.
paraphrase: 中庭 → the midface / middle third
scenes.speak: Long midface? Keep the brows flat. Short midface? Arch the brows up. Brows are a key factor in your looks.

scenes.context: 颧骨凸，眉就要柔；颧骨平，眉就要立。太阳穴凹，眉尾就要窄；太阳穴满，眉尾就要收。语域：美妆口诀，脸型分析。
sentences: Hollow temples? Narrow the brow tails.
paraphrase: 颧骨 → the cheekbones / the cheek arch
眉尾 → the brow tails / the tail end
scenes.speak: Prominent cheekbones? Soften the brows. Flat cheekbones? Define the brows. Hollow temples? Narrow the brow tails.

scenes.context: 眼距近，眉就要远；眼距远，眉就要近。眼睛大，眉就要粗；眼睛小，眉就要细。语域：美妆口诀，五官分析。
sentences: Close-set eyes? Push the brows apart.
Wide-set eyes? Bring the brows in.
Big eyes? Go with thicker brows.
paraphrase: 眼距 → eye spacing / the gap between eyes
眉距 → brow distance / how close they start
scenes.speak: Close-set eyes? Push the brows apart. Wide-set eyes? Bring the brows in. Big eyes? Go with thicker brows.

scenes.context: 下颌宽，眉就要长；下颌窄，眉就要短。用眉毛的长短平衡下颌的视觉宽度。语域：美妆口诀，收尾。
sentences: 用眉毛，平衡下颌的视觉宽度。
Brows balance the jaw's visual width.
paraphrase: 下颌 → the jaw / the lower face
视觉宽度 → the visual width / how wide it reads
visual width · how wide it reads
scenes.speak: Wide jaw? Lengthen the brows. Narrow jaw? Shorten the brows. Brows balance the jaw's visual width.

practice: Long midface? Keep the brows flat.
Close-set eyes? Push the brows apart.
pitfalls: Long midface? Keep the brows flat.
Short midface? Arch the brows up.
Small eyes? Go with thinner brows.
注意：眼睛小，眉要细（thinner），不是粗。
shifts: 用 the midface（中庭）、the cheekbones（颧骨）、hollow temples（太阳穴凹）、the jaw（下颌）
用 close-set eyes（眼距近）、wide-set eyes（眼距远）、brow tails（眉尾）、brow distance（眉距）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：中挺→中庭、全骨→颧骨、太陽穴→太阳穴、美貌→眉（貌）/眉形、下河→下颌、美尾→眉尾、遠→远、挑、柔、立、收、粗、細等。
